verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies that agent payments ride standard Visa rails. The agent token is a 'pass-through payment token… intended for use at Visa-accepting merchant locations', authorizations run through VisaNet, TAP mentions funds being available 'when settlement occurs', and payment outcomes can be confirmed in real time. Nothing documents payout, settlement reporting or reconciliation flows for agent-originated transactions. Missing for 10: documented settlement/payout flow for agent transactions, reporting or reconciliation exports identifying the agent channel, confirmation that agent payments reconcile alongside other channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
